h1.en: Trelegy vs Symbicort vs Breo Ellipta: COPD Inhaler Cost Comparison for 2026
h1.es: Trelegy vs Symbicort vs Breo Ellipta: Comparacion de Costo de Inhaladores para EPOC en 2026

subhero.en: Trelegy Ellipta, Symbicort, and Breo Ellipta are three of the most-prescribed COPD maintenance inhalers in the United States, and their 2026 costs diverge sharply. Trelegy runs $698 to $930 per inhaler at retail and Breo runs $380 to $550, and both carry Medicare-negotiated Maximum Fair Prices of $175 and $67 per month respectively, effective January 1, 2027, under the Inflation Reduction Act. Symbicort, which already faces generic competition from budesonide/formoterol (marketed as Breyna since 2022), was not selected for IRA negotiation and retails for $330 to $530 per inhaler, though its generic can cost as little as $97 with a discount coupon. This comparison breaks down retail cash prices, GoodRx and pharmacy-chain pricing, Medicare Part D rules, and each manufacturer's patient assistance program side by side.
subhero.es: Trelegy Ellipta, Symbicort y Breo Ellipta son tres de los inhaladores de mantenimiento para EPOC mas recetados en Estados Unidos, y sus costos de 2026 difieren notablemente. Trelegy cuesta entre $698 y $930 por inhalador al por menor y Breo entre $380 y $550, y ambos tienen Precios Maximos Justos negociados por Medicare de $175 y $67 por mes respectivamente, vigentes a partir del 1 de enero de 2027, bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion. Symbicort, que ya enfrenta competencia generica de budesonida/formoterol (comercializado como Breyna desde 2022), no fue seleccionado para la negociacion IRA y se vende al por menor entre $330 y $530 por inhalador, aunque su generico puede costar tan solo $97 con un cupon de descuento.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, brand-name COPD inhaler prices range from about $330 per month for Symbicort to roughly $930 per month for Trelegy Ellipta without insurance. Medicare Part D enrollees will pay the IRA-negotiated Maximum Fair Price of $175 per month for Trelegy Ellipta and $67 per month for Breo Ellipta starting January 1, 2027, while Symbicort was excluded from negotiation because generic budesonide/formoterol (Breyna) already competes with the brand since 2022. Generic budesonide/formoterol costs $97 to $223 per month with a GoodRx coupon, making it the cheapest option among the three by a wide margin. GSK runs the GSK For You patient assistance program (approximately 300% of the Federal Poverty Level) for Trelegy and Breo, while AstraZeneca runs the AZ&Me Prescription Savings Program for Symbicort at that same approximately 300% FPL threshold. All out-of-pocket Part D spending across all three inhalers counts toward the same 2026 annual $2,100 cap.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, los precios de marca de los inhaladores para EPOC van desde aproximadamente $330 por mes para Symbicort hasta cerca de $930 por mes para Trelegy Ellipta sin seguro. Los inscritos en Medicare Parte D pagaran el Precio Maximo Justo negociado por la IRA de $175 por mes para Trelegy Ellipta y $67 por mes para Breo Ellipta a partir del 1 de enero de 2027, mientras que Symbicort fue excluido de la negociacion porque el budesonida/formoterol generico (Breyna) ya compite con la marca desde 2022. El budesonida/formoterol generico cuesta $97 a $223 por mes con un cupon de GoodRx, lo que lo convierte en la opcion mas economica entre los tres por un amplio margen. GSK opera el programa de asistencia al paciente GSK For You (aproximadamente 300% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza) para Trelegy y Breo, mientras que AstraZeneca opera el Programa de Ahorro de Recetas AZ&Me para Symbicort en ese mismo umbral de aproximadamente 300% FPL. Todo el gasto de bolsillo de la Parte D entre los tres inhaladores cuenta hacia el mismo limite anual de $2,100 de 2026.

callout.en: Two of the three COPD inhalers compared here were selected for Round 2 of Medicare's Inflation Reduction Act price negotiation. Trelegy Ellipta carries a Maximum Fair Price of $175 per 30-day supply, down 73 percent from a pre-negotiation list price of $654, effective January 1, 2027. Breo Ellipta carries a Maximum Fair Price of $67 per 30-day supply, down 83 percent from a list price of $397, also effective January 1, 2027. Symbicort was never eligible for IRA negotiation because generic budesonide/formoterol, marketed as Breyna, has competed with the brand since March 2022; the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 bars CMS from selecting drugs that already face generic or biosimilar competition.

introParagraphs.en: Trelegy Ellipta, Symbicort, and Breo Ellipta are three of the highest-volume maintenance inhalers prescribed for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in the United States, and each represents a different tier of the treatment ladder. Trelegy Ellipta combines fluticasone furoate, umeclidinium, and vilanterol in a single once-daily inhaler, making it the only triple-combination therapy (ICS/LABA/LAMA) of the three, typically prescribed for more advanced COPD. Symbicort (budesonide/formoterol) and Breo Ellipta (fluticasone furoate/vilanterol) are both dual-combination ICS/LABA inhalers used for earlier-stage maintenance treatment. GSK manufactures both Trelegy and Breo using the same Ellipta dry-powder device, while AstraZeneca manufactures Symbicort as a pressurized metered-dose inhaler. Those device and formulation differences do not change how each drug is billed, but the three inhalers have sharply different generic status, IRA negotiation status, and manufacturer assistance programs in 2026, which is why comparing them side by side matters more for your wallet than which device you use.
introParagraphs.es: Trelegy Ellipta, Symbicort y Breo Ellipta son tres de los inhaladores de mantenimiento mas recetados para la enfermedad pulmonar obstructiva cronica (EPOC) en Estados Unidos, y cada uno representa un nivel diferente de la escala de tratamiento. Trelegy Ellipta combina furoato de fluticasona, umeclidinio y vilanterol en un solo inhalador de una vez al dia, lo que lo convierte en la unica terapia de combinacion triple (ICS/LABA/LAMA) de los tres. Symbicort (budesonida/formoterol) y Breo Ellipta (furoato de fluticasona/vilanterol) son inhaladores de combinacion dual ICS/LABA usados para el tratamiento de mantenimiento en etapas mas tempranas. GSK fabrica tanto Trelegy como Breo usando el mismo dispositivo de polvo seco Ellipta, mientras que AstraZeneca fabrica Symbicort como un inhalador de dosis medida presurizado.

introParagraphs.en: The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, signed August 16, 2022, authorized CMS to negotiate Medicare drug prices directly with manufacturers. Trelegy Ellipta and Breo Ellipta were both selected for Round 2 of that negotiation on January 17, 2025, and their Maximum Fair Prices of $175 and $67 per month take effect January 1, 2027. CMS reported that roughly 1.3 million Medicare beneficiaries use Trelegy Ellipta and about 626,000 use Breo Ellipta, which drove their selection as high-spend Part D drugs. Symbicort was excluded from the negotiation process entirely because generic budesonide/formoterol had already launched under the Breyna brand in March 2022, and the statute bars CMS from selecting drugs that already face meaningful generic competition. That single distinction, generic availability, is the biggest driver of the 2026 cost gap between Symbicort and its two brand-protected competitors, and it means Symbicort patients should focus on generic substitution rather than waiting for a negotiated Medicare price that will not arrive for this drug.
introParagraphs.es: La Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022, firmada el 16 de agosto de 2022, autorizo a CMS a negociar directamente los precios de medicamentos de Medicare con los fabricantes. Trelegy Ellipta y Breo Ellipta fueron seleccionados para la Ronda 2 de esa negociacion el 17 de enero de 2025, y sus Precios Maximos Justos de $175 y $67 por mes entran en vigor el 1 de enero de 2027. Symbicort fue excluido por completo del proceso de negociacion porque el budesonida/formoterol generico ya se habia lanzado bajo la marca Breyna en marzo de 2022, y la ley prohibe a CMS seleccionar medicamentos que ya enfrentan competencia generica significativa. Esa unica distincion, la disponibilidad generica, es el mayor impulsor de la brecha de costos de 2026 entre Symbicort y sus dos competidores protegidos por marca.

introParagraphs.en: Patients switching between these three inhalers for cost reasons should talk to their prescriber first, since Trelegy's triple-therapy formulation is not clinically interchangeable with the dual-combination Symbicort or Breo. All three drugs are self-administered at home through retail or mail-order pharmacies, so all three are billed under Medicare Part D, not Part B, and none carries an HCPCS J-code. None of the three is a biologic, so no biosimilar exists or is expected for any of them; the biosimilar approval pathway applies only to large-molecule drugs, not to these small-molecule inhaled combinations. The comparison table below lays out cash price, Medicare Part D treatment, generic availability, and manufacturer patient assistance program for all three inhalers side by side.
introParagraphs.es: Los pacientes que cambian entre estos tres inhaladores por razones de costo deben hablar primero con su medico prescriptor, ya que la formulacion de triple terapia de Trelegy no es clinicamente intercambiable con la combinacion dual de Symbicort o Breo. Los tres medicamentos se autoadministran en casa a traves de farmacias minoristas o por correo, por lo que los tres se facturan bajo Medicare Parte D, no Parte B, y ninguno tiene un codigo J de HCPCS. Ninguno de los tres es un biologico, por lo que no existe ni se espera un biosimilar para ninguno de ellos.

paragraphs.en: Hospitals rarely bill Trelegy Ellipta, Symbicort, or Breo Ellipta as standalone pharmacy line items when a dose is given during an inpatient stay. Instead, doses of any of the three inhalers given while admitted are bundled into the Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) payment Medicare pays the hospital for that admission, regardless of which specific inhaler was used. Private insurers negotiate their own bundled inpatient rates separately from any single drug's retail price. Patients who see a separate itemized charge for one of these inhalers on a hospital bill should treat it as a likely billing error and request an itemized review.
paragraphs.es: Los hospitales rara vez facturan Trelegy Ellipta, Symbicort o Breo Ellipta como elementos de linea de farmacia independientes cuando se administra una dosis durante una hospitalizacion. En cambio, las dosis de cualquiera de los tres inhaladores administradas durante la internacion se incluyen en el pago del Grupo Relacionado por Diagnostico (DRG) que Medicare paga al hospital por esa admision. Los pacientes que vean un cargo detallado separado por uno de estos inhaladores en una factura del hospital deben tratarlo como un probable error de facturacion.

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part A stops paying for any of the three inhalers the moment a patient is discharged, and coverage shifts entirely to Medicare Part D for the outpatient prescription. That transition is where the 2027 IRA Maximum Fair Price for Trelegy Ellipta ($175/month) and Breo Ellipta ($67/month) will kick in, along with standard Part D formulary tier cost-sharing for Symbicort. Patients discharged on a new COPD inhaler prescription without an active Part D plan often face sticker shock at the outpatient pharmacy because they assumed the inpatient DRG rate would carry over. Anyone leaving the hospital on Trelegy, Symbicort, or Breo without Part D coverage should call 1-800-MEDICARE before the first fill.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte A deja de pagar cualquiera de los tres inhaladores en el momento en que el paciente es dado de alta, y la cobertura pasa completamente a Medicare Parte D para la receta ambulatoria. Esa transicion es donde entrara en vigor el Precio Maximo Justo IRA de 2027 para Trelegy Ellipta ($175/mes) y Breo Ellipta ($67/mes), junto con el costo compartido estandar del nivel de formulario de Parte D para Symbicort.

paragraphs.en: Generic budesonide/formoterol, sold as Breyna since March 2022, remains the lowest-cost fallback across all three inhaler scenarios at $97 to $223 per month with a discount coupon, roughly 60 to 80 percent below the Symbicort brand cash price. None of the three inhalers compared here is a biologic, so the biosimilar approval pathway that lowers costs for drugs like Humira or Stelara simply does not exist for fluticasone furoate, budesonide, or their paired bronchodilators; cost reduction for these three drugs comes only through small-molecule generic competition, IRA negotiation, or manufacturer patient assistance. Patients who cannot afford Trelegy or Breo should ask their prescriber whether a step-down to generic budesonide/formoterol is clinically appropriate rather than skipping doses, since untreated COPD exacerbations can lead to costly hospitalizations.
paragraphs.es: El budesonida/formoterol generico, vendido como Breyna desde marzo de 2022, sigue siendo la alternativa de menor costo en los tres escenarios de inhaladores a $97 a $223 por mes con un cupon de descuento. Ninguno de los tres inhaladores comparados aqui es un biologico, por lo que la via de aprobacion de biosimilares que reduce costos para medicamentos como Humira o Stelara simplemente no existe para el furoato de fluticasona, la budesonida o sus broncodilatadores emparejados.

note.en: The three inhalers have three different generic outcomes in 2026. Symbicort (budesonide/formoterol) has had full generic competition since March 2022, when the FDA approved Mylan's generic metered-dose inhaler, now sold under the Breyna brand; generic pricing runs $97 to $223 per month via discount coupon, roughly 60 to 80 percent below the Symbicort brand cash price. Breo Ellipta has an authorized generic (fluticasone furoate/vilanterol, manufactured by Prasco under license from GSK) available since May 2022, but its list price does not consistently undercut the brand, so comparing both prices before filling matters. A true ANDA generic for Breo from Transpire Bio was accepted for FDA review in September 2025 but has not been approved as of 2026. Trelegy Ellipta has no commercially available generic or authorized generic in the US; its complex triple-combination Ellipta device has slowed generic entry, and no ANDA has been approved as of 2026. None of the three inhalers is a biologic, so the biosimilar regulatory pathway used for drugs like insulin or Humira does not apply to any of them; cost reduction for these inhalers depends entirely on small-molecule generic competition, IRA negotiation, or manufacturer patient assistance.
note.es: Los tres inhaladores tienen tres resultados genericos diferentes en 2026. Symbicort (budesonida/formoterol) ha tenido competencia generica completa desde marzo de 2022, cuando la FDA aprobo el inhalador generico de dosis medida de Mylan, ahora vendido bajo la marca Breyna; los precios genericos oscilan entre $97 y $223 por mes con cupon de descuento. Breo Ellipta tiene un generico autorizado (furoato de fluticasona/vilanterol, fabricado por Prasco bajo licencia de GSK) disponible desde mayo de 2022, pero su precio de lista no siempre es menor que el de la marca. Trelegy Ellipta no tiene generico ni generico autorizado disponible comercialmente en EE.UU.; su complejo dispositivo Ellipta de combinacion triple ha retrasado la entrada de genericos. Ninguno de los tres inhaladores es un biologico, por lo que la via regulatoria de biosimilares no aplica a ninguno de ellos.

intro.en: GSK and AstraZeneca each run separate patient assistance programs for their inhalers, and the eligibility structure differs meaningfully between the two manufacturers. If you have no insurance and a modest income, the cost of your COPD inhaler may be $0 through the correct manufacturer program, but you must apply to the manufacturer of your specific prescribed drug; there is no single combined COPD inhaler assistance program covering all three.
intro.es: GSK y AstraZeneca operan cada uno programas de asistencia al paciente separados para sus inhaladores, y la estructura de elegibilidad difiere significativamente entre los dos fabricantes. Si no tiene seguro y tiene un ingreso modesto, el costo de su inhalador para EPOC puede ser $0 a traves del programa correcto del fabricante, pero debe solicitar al fabricante de su medicamento especifico recetado.

costBenefit.es: Trelegy o Breo gratuito para pacientes sin seguro o con seguro insuficiente con ingresos familiares hasta aproximadamente 300% FPL ($47,880 para un hogar de 1 en 2026)

costBenefit.es: $0 a $35/mes para pacientes con seguro comercial en toda la cartera de inhaladores de asma y EPOC de GSK, vigente desde enero de 2025

footnote.en: Manufacturer savings cards for all three inhalers (GSK's $35/month program and AstraZeneca's Symbicort Affordability Program) are not available to Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA beneficiaries by federal law (anti-kickback statute, 42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b). If you have any government insurance, use the manufacturer's income-based patient assistance program instead of a savings card, or apply for Medicare Part D Extra Help through Social Security at 1-800-772-1213.
footnote.es: Las tarjetas de ahorro del fabricante para los tres inhaladores (el programa de $35/mes de GSK y el Programa de Asequibilidad de Symbicort de AstraZeneca) no estan disponibles para beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA por ley federal (estatuto anti-soborno, 42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b). Si tiene cualquier seguro del gobierno, use el programa de asistencia al paciente basado en ingresos del fabricante en lugar de una tarjeta de ahorro.

howToApplyPap.programName: GSK For You Patient Assistance Program - Trelegy Ellipta and Breo Ellipta (representative example; steps are similar for AstraZeneca's AZ&Me program for Symbicort at azandmeapp.com or 1-800-292-6363)

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Visit gskforyou.com or call 1-888-825-5249 (for Trelegy or Breo), or visit azandmeapp.com or call 1-800-292-6363 (for Symbicort), to confirm eligibility for your specific drug before completing paperwork. If you have Medicare, apply for Part D Extra Help first at 1-800-772-1213.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Visite gskforyou.com o llame al 1-888-825-5249 (para Trelegy o Breo), o visite azandmeapp.com o llame al 1-800-292-6363 (para Symbicort), para confirmar la elegibilidad de su medicamento especifico antes de completar el papeleo.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Download the patient application form from the manufacturer's website. Complete the patient section (name, address, household income, household size, insurance status) and have your prescriber complete and sign the prescriber section.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Descargue el formulario de solicitud del paciente desde el sitio web del fabricante. Complete la seccion del paciente y haga que su medico prescriptor complete y firme la seccion del prescriptor.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Gather required documents: most recent federal tax return or 4 consecutive pay stubs showing household income, proof of US residency, a valid prescription for the specific inhaler, and documentation showing no current prescription drug insurance covering that drug.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Reuna los documentos requeridos: declaracion de impuestos federal mas reciente o 4 recibos de pago consecutivos que muestren ingresos familiares, comprobante de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida para el inhalador especifico y documentacion que muestre que no tiene seguro de medicamentos con receta que cubra ese medicamento.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Submit the completed application and documents to the manufacturer's program by fax, mail, or online portal as listed on their website. Processing typically takes 2 to 4 weeks depending on the manufacturer.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Envie la solicitud completa y los documentos al programa del fabricante por fax, correo o portal en linea segun se indica en su sitio web. El procesamiento generalmente toma de 2 a 4 semanas dependiendo del fabricante.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: If approved, the manufacturer ships the inhaler directly to your home or your prescriber's office at no charge. Enrollment is generally valid for 12 months; annual re-enrollment requires resubmitting income documentation.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Si es aprobado, el fabricante envia el inhalador directamente a su domicilio o al consultorio de su medico prescriptor sin cargo. La inscripcion generalmente es valida por 12 meses; la reinscripcion anual requiere volver a presentar documentacion de ingresos.

documentsNeeded.en: Proof of US residency (utility bill, lease agreement, or government-issued photo ID)
documentsNeeded.es: Comprobante de residencia en EE.UU. (factura de servicios publicos, contrato de arrendamiento o identificacion emitida por el gobierno)

documentsNeeded.en: Valid prescription for the specific inhaler (Trelegy Ellipta, Symbicort, or Breo Ellipta) from a US-licensed prescriber
documentsNeeded.es: Receta valida para el inhalador especifico (Trelegy Ellipta, Symbicort o Breo Ellipta) de un medico con licencia en EE.UU.

documentsNeeded.en: Completed patient section of the manufacturer's application form
documentsNeeded.es: Seccion del paciente completa del formulario de solicitud del fabricante
Seccion del medico prescriptor completa y firmada

documentsNeeded.en: Documentation showing no current prescription drug insurance covering the specific inhaler
documentsNeeded.es: Documentacion que muestre que no tiene seguro de medicamentos con receta que cubra el inhalador especifico

documentsNeeded.en: For AZ&Me applicants: year-to-date prescription spend history and prescriber's state license and NPI number
documentsNeeded.es: Para solicitantes de AZ&Me: historial de gastos de recetas del ano hasta la fecha y numero de licencia estatal y NPI del medico prescriptor

commonDenialReasons.en: Household income exceeds the manufacturer's threshold for that specific drug (approximately 300% FPL for both GSK For You and AZ&Me for Symbicort)
commonDenialReasons.es: Los ingresos familiares superan el umbral del fabricante para ese medicamento especifico (aproximadamente 300% FPL tanto para GSK For You como para AZ&Me en el caso de Symbicort)

commonDenialReasons.en: Incomplete application or missing prescriber signature
commonDenialReasons.es: Solicitud incompleta o falta la firma del medico prescriptor

commonDenialReasons.en: Patient already has prescription drug coverage that includes the specific inhaler
commonDenialReasons.es: El paciente ya tiene cobertura de medicamentos con receta que incluye el inhalador especifico

commonDenialReasons.en: Not a US resident, or the prescription was written by a non-US-licensed prescriber
commonDenialReasons.es: No es residente de EE.UU., o la receta fue escrita por un medico sin licencia en EE.UU.

commonDenialReasons.en: Medicare beneficiary applied to AZ&Me while already enrolled in Part D Extra Help (Low Income Subsidy), which disqualifies AZ&Me enrollment for that drug
commonDenialReasons.es: Beneficiario de Medicare que solicito AZ&Me mientras ya estaba inscrito en Extra Help de la Parte D, lo que descalifica la inscripcion en AZ&Me para ese medicamento

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part D treats these three inhalers very differently starting in 2027. Trelegy Ellipta and Breo Ellipta will be subject to the IRA Maximum Fair Price of $175 and $67 per month respectively, applied at any network pharmacy regardless of which specific plan you carry. Symbicort has no negotiated price; your out-of-pocket cost depends entirely on your Part D plan's formulary tier for brand Symbicort versus generic budesonide/formoterol, and most plans place the generic on a much lower tier with a smaller copay than the two IRA-negotiated brands. In 2026, before the negotiated prices take effect, all three inhalers are covered under standard Part D formulary rules. All out-of-pocket spending on any of the three drugs counts toward the same 2026 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100; once you hit that cap across all your Part D drugs combined, you pay $0 for the rest of the calendar year.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte D trata a estos tres inhaladores de manera muy diferente a partir de 2027. Trelegy Ellipta y Breo Ellipta estaran sujetos al Precio Maximo Justo IRA de $175 y $67 por mes respectivamente, aplicado en cualquier farmacia de la red sin importar el plan especifico que tenga. Symbicort no tiene un precio negociado; su costo de bolsillo depende completamente del nivel de formulario de su plan Parte D para Symbicort de marca versus budesonida/formoterol generico.

paragraphs.en: Prior authorization and step therapy are common Part D requirements for Trelegy Ellipta and Breo Ellipta, meaning patients may need to document that they tried a lower-cost ICS/LABA combination, such as generic budesonide/formoterol, before a plan will cover the triple-combination or brand dual-combination inhaler. Extra Help (the Part D Low Income Subsidy) reduces cost-sharing further for beneficiaries with limited income and resources. In 2026, Extra Help enrollees pay a small copay per fill for brand-name inhalers and less for generic budesonide/formoterol. Extra Help is generally available to beneficiaries with income at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level. Apply through the Social Security Administration at 1-800-772-1213 or at ssa.gov.
paragraphs.es: La autorizacion previa y la terapia escalonada son requisitos comunes de la Parte D para Trelegy Ellipta y Breo Ellipta, lo que significa que los pacientes pueden necesitar documentar que intentaron primero una combinacion ICS/LABA de menor costo, como budesonida/formoterol generico. Extra Help (el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos de la Parte D) reduce aun mas el costo compartido para los beneficiarios con ingresos y recursos limitados.

intro.en: All three COPD inhalers are self-administered and billed through Part D or a commercial pharmacy benefit rather than Part B, so most billing problems appear on pharmacy claims or Explanation of Benefits statements rather than hospital bills. Watch for these issues:
intro.es: Los tres inhaladores para EPOC se autoadministran y se facturan a traves de la Parte D o un beneficio de farmacia comercial en lugar de la Parte B, por lo que la mayoria de los problemas de facturacion aparecen en reclamos de farmacia. Verifique estos problemas:

items.en: Pharmacy charges more than the $175 Trelegy or $67 Breo IRA Maximum Fair Price for a Medicare Part D fill starting in 2027, which violates federal law; ask your plan's member services to reprocess the claim.
items.es: La farmacia cobra mas del Precio Maximo Justo IRA de $175 para Trelegy o $67 para Breo en una reposicion de Medicare Parte D a partir de 2027, lo que viola la ley federal; pida al servicio de miembros de su plan que reprocese el reclamo.

items.en: Generic budesonide/formoterol billed at the Symbicort brand-name price instead of the generic tier.
items.es: Budesonida/formoterol generico facturado al precio de marca de Symbicort en lugar del nivel generico.

items.en: Manufacturer savings card (GSK's $35 program or AstraZeneca's Symbicort Affordability Program) applied for a patient who has Medicare or Medicaid, which is prohibited and can result in a claim clawback later.
items.es: Tarjeta de ahorro del fabricante aplicada a un paciente que tiene Medicare o Medicaid, lo cual esta prohibido y puede resultar en una recuperacion del reclamo mas tarde.

items.en: Step therapy denial requiring a generic budesonide/formoterol trial without documenting that the generic was already tried and failed or is clinically inappropriate.
items.es: Denegacion de terapia escalonada que requiere una prueba de budesonida/formoterol generico sin documentar que ya se probo y fallo o que es clinicamente inapropiado.

items.en: Wrong strength or wrong inhaler billed, for example Symbicort's 160/4.5mcg strength billed when the 80/4.5mcg was dispensed, or Breo billed when Trelegy was actually filled, which can trigger an incorrect copay.
items.es: Dosis o inhalador incorrecto facturado, por ejemplo la dosis de 160/4.5mcg de Symbicort facturada cuando se dispenso la de 80/4.5mcg, o Breo facturado cuando en realidad se surtio Trelegy.

items.en: Charged the standard copay after you already hit the $2,100 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap for the year across all your combined Part D drugs.
items.es: Se le cobro el copago estandar despues de que ya alcanzo el limite anual de bolsillo de la Parte D de $2,100 para el ano entre todos sus medicamentos combinados de Parte D.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written denial notice from your insurer or Part D plan. Federal law requires written notice within 72 hours for standard decisions, or 24 hours for expedited (urgent) requests, stating the specific reason for denial and your appeal rights.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito de su aseguradora o plan Parte D. La ley federal requiere aviso escrito dentro de las 72 horas para decisiones estandar, o 24 horas para solicitudes urgentes.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: File a formal appeal within 60 days of the written denial. Include a prescriber letter documenting your COPD severity, spirometry results if available, and why the plan's preferred alternative is not clinically appropriate for your condition.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias del aviso de denegacion por escrito. Incluya una carta del medico prescriptor que documente la gravedad de su EPOC.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: Ask your prescriber to request a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director, documenting why a lower-cost inhaler is contraindicated, already failed, or carries specific risks given your comorbidities.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Solicite a su medico prescriptor que pida una revision medico a medico con el director medico del plan.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: If the internal appeal is denied, escalate to an Independent Review Entity for Medicare Part D plans at 1-800-633-4227, or to your state Department of Insurance for commercial plans. Medicare beneficiaries can also contact their State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) for free counseling.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Si la apelacion interna es denegada, escale a una Entidad de Revision Independiente para planes Medicare Parte D al 1-800-633-4227, o al Departamento de Seguros de su estado para planes comerciales.

stepTherapyOverride.en: If your plan requires step therapy (trying generic budesonide/formoterol or a cheaper dual-combination inhaler first), your prescriber can file a step-therapy exception by documenting that the required first-step drug is medically contraindicated, was already tried and failed (inadequate symptom control, adverse events, or intolerance), or that requiring it would cause serious harm given the severity of your COPD, such as a recent exacerbation requiring hospitalization. Medicare and most state laws require plans to decide on a step-therapy exception within 72 hours of complete documentation, or 24 hours for urgent cases.
stepTherapyOverride.es: Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada (probar budesonida/formoterol generico o un inhalador de combinacion dual mas economico primero), su medico prescriptor puede presentar una excepcion de terapia escalonada documentando que el medicamento de primer paso requerido esta medicamente contraindicado, ya se probo y fallo, o que requerirlo causaria dano grave dada la gravedad de su EPOC.

papFallback.en: If appeals fail, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific inhaler: GSK For You (gskforyou.com) for Trelegy or Breo, or the AstraZeneca AZ&Me Prescription Savings Program (azandmeapp.com) for Symbicort. Each has a different eligibility structure, so check the one that applies to your prescribed drug before assuming you do not qualify.
papFallback.es: Si las apelaciones fallan, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su inhalador especifico: GSK For You (gskforyou.com) para Trelegy o Breo, o el Programa de Ahorro de Recetas AZ&Me de AstraZeneca (azandmeapp.com) para Symbicort.

genericAlternative.en: Generic budesonide/formoterol (Symbicort, sold as Breyna) is the most complete generic alternative among the three, at $97 to $223 per month with a discount coupon. Breo Ellipta's authorized generic exists but is not always cheaper than the brand. No generic exists for Trelegy Ellipta's triple-combination formulation as of 2026. Patients on Trelegy who are stable on a lower level of therapy may discuss stepping down to generic budesonide/formoterol or another dual-combination ICS/LABA with their prescriber, though this substitution is not clinically equivalent for patients who need the added LAMA component. Discuss any substitution with your prescriber before switching.
genericAlternative.es: El budesonida/formoterol generico (Symbicort, vendido como Breyna) es la alternativa generica mas completa entre los tres, a $97 a $223 por mes con cupon de descuento. El generico autorizado de Breo Ellipta existe pero no siempre es mas barato que la marca. No existe generico para la formulacion de combinacion triple de Trelegy Ellipta en 2026.

en.question: Is there a generic for Trelegy, Symbicort, or Breo Ellipta?
en.answer: Yes for two of the three. Symbicort has a full generic (budesonide/formoterol, sold as Breyna) available since March 2022 at $97 to $223 per month with a discount coupon. Breo Ellipta has an authorized generic (fluticasone furoate/vilanterol by Prasco) since May 2022, though it is not always priced lower than the brand. Trelegy Ellipta has no generic or authorized generic as of 2026; its triple-combination Ellipta device has slowed generic entry.

en.question: How do I apply for a COPD inhaler patient assistance program?
en.answer: Apply to the manufacturer of your specific drug: GSK For You at gskforyou.com or 1-888-825-5249 for Trelegy or Breo Ellipta, or AstraZeneca's AZ&Me program at azandmeapp.com or 1-800-292-6363 for Symbicort. Each requires proof of income, proof of US residency, a valid prescription, and documentation that you have no prescription drug coverage for that drug. Processing takes 2 to 4 weeks, and approved patients typically receive a 12-month supply that requires annual re-enrollment.

en.question: Can I use a Trelegy, Symbicort, or Breo savings card with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback law (42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b) bars Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, and VA beneficiaries from using any manufacturer copay savings card, including GSK's $35/month program for Trelegy and Breo and AstraZeneca's Symbicort Affordability Program. Medicare Part D patients on Trelegy or Breo should instead rely on the 2027 IRA Maximum Fair Price ($175 and $67 respectively), and Symbicort patients should apply for Part D Extra Help or the AZ&Me PAP if they cannot afford the formulary copay.

en.question: What if my insurance denies coverage for my COPD inhaler?
en.answer: Request a written denial notice, then file a formal appeal within 60 days with a prescriber letter documenting medical necessity. If your plan requires step therapy with a cheaper inhaler first, your prescriber can file a step-therapy exception documenting contraindication, prior failure, or urgent risk such as a recent COPD exacerbation. If the appeal fails, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific inhaler as a fallback.

en.question: Does the IRA negotiated price apply to Trelegy, Symbicort, and Breo Ellipta?
en.answer: It applies to two of the three. Trelegy Ellipta and Breo Ellipta were both selected for Medicare's Round 2 Inflation Reduction Act negotiation, with Maximum Fair Prices of $175 and $67 per month respectively, effective January 1, 2027. Symbicort was never eligible because generic budesonide/formoterol (Breyna) has competed with the brand since March 2022; drugs with existing generic competition are excluded from IRA negotiation by statute.

en.question: What does each COPD inhaler cost without insurance at the pharmacy counter in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance, Symbicort brand runs $330 to $530 per month depending on strength, Breo Ellipta runs $380 to $550 per month, and Trelegy Ellipta runs $698 to $930 per month. With a GoodRx coupon, generic budesonide/formoterol (Symbicort) drops to $97 to $223 per month, making it by far the cheapest of the three. Breo's authorized generic and coupon pricing run $225 to $280 per month, and Trelegy, which has no generic, drops to about $554 to $690 per month at best.

en.question: Do I qualify for a COPD inhaler patient assistance program based on my income?
en.answer: GSK For You for Trelegy and Breo and AstraZeneca's AZ&Me program for Symbicort both generally require household income at or below approximately 300% of the Federal Poverty Level ($47,880 for one person in 2026). Each program verifies eligibility separately, so check the program for your specific prescribed drug rather than assuming approval for one automatically covers the other.

en.question: Which COPD inhaler is cheapest: Trelegy, Symbicort, or Breo?
en.answer: For uninsured patients without a manufacturer PAP, generic budesonide/formoterol (Symbicort, sold as Breyna) is the cheapest at $97 to $223 per month, since it is the only one of the three with a full, widely available generic. For Medicare Part D patients starting in 2027, Breo Ellipta becomes the cheapest brand option at a $67 Maximum Fair Price, followed by Trelegy Ellipta at $175, while Symbicort's cost depends on your plan's formulary tier for the brand versus generic budesonide/formoterol.

es.question: Hay un generico para Trelegy, Symbicort o Breo Ellipta?
es.answer: Si para dos de los tres. Symbicort tiene un generico completo (budesonida/formoterol, vendido como Breyna) disponible desde marzo de 2022 a $97 a $223 por mes con cupon de descuento. Breo Ellipta tiene un generico autorizado (furoato de fluticasona/vilanterol de Prasco) desde mayo de 2022, aunque no siempre tiene un precio menor que la marca. Trelegy Ellipta no tiene generico ni generico autorizado en 2026.

es.question: Como solicito un programa de asistencia al paciente para un inhalador de EPOC?
es.answer: Solicite al fabricante de su medicamento especifico: GSK For You en gskforyou.com o 1-888-825-5249 para Trelegy o Breo Ellipta, o el programa AZ&Me de AstraZeneca en azandmeapp.com o 1-800-292-6363 para Symbicort. Cada uno requiere comprobante de ingresos, comprobante de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida y documentacion de que no tiene cobertura de medicamentos con receta para ese medicamento.

es.question: Puedo usar una tarjeta de ahorro de Trelegy, Symbicort o Breo con Medicare?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno (42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b) prohibe a los beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE y VA usar cualquier tarjeta de ahorro de copago del fabricante, incluyendo el programa de $35/mes de GSK y el Programa de Asequibilidad de Symbicort de AstraZeneca. Los pacientes de Medicare Parte D con Trelegy o Breo deben confiar en el Precio Maximo Justo IRA de 2027 en su lugar.

es.question: Que hago si mi seguro deniega la cobertura de mi inhalador para EPOC?
es.answer: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito, luego presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias con una carta del medico prescriptor que documente la necesidad medica. Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada con un inhalador mas economico, su medico prescriptor puede presentar una excepcion. Si la apelacion falla, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su inhalador especifico.

es.question: Aplica el precio negociado de la IRA a Trelegy, Symbicort y Breo Ellipta?
es.answer: Aplica a dos de los tres. Trelegy Ellipta y Breo Ellipta fueron seleccionados para la Ronda 2 de negociacion de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, con Precios Maximos Justos de $175 y $67 por mes respectivamente, efectivos el 1 de enero de 2027. Symbicort nunca fue elegible porque el budesonida/formoterol generico (Breyna) ya competia con la marca desde marzo de 2022.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta cada inhalador para EPOC sin seguro en la farmacia en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro, Symbicort de marca cuesta $330 a $530 por mes segun la dosis, Breo Ellipta cuesta $380 a $550 por mes y Trelegy Ellipta cuesta $698 a $930 por mes. Con un cupon de GoodRx, el budesonida/formoterol generico (Symbicort) baja a $97 a $223 por mes, lo que lo convierte por mucho en el mas economico de los tres.

es.question: Califico para un programa de asistencia al paciente para inhaladores de EPOC segun mis ingresos?
es.answer: GSK For You para Trelegy y Breo y el programa AZ&Me de AstraZeneca para Symbicort generalmente requieren ingresos familiares hasta aproximadamente 300% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($47,880 para una persona en 2026). Cada programa verifica la elegibilidad por separado, asi que consulte el programa correspondiente a su medicamento especifico.

es.question: Cual inhalador para EPOC es mas barato: Trelegy, Symbicort o Breo?
es.answer: Para pacientes sin seguro y sin un PAP del fabricante, el budesonida/formoterol generico (Symbicort, vendido como Breyna) es el mas barato a $97 a $223 por mes, ya que es el unico de los tres con un generico completo y ampliamente disponible. Para pacientes de Medicare Parte D a partir de 2027, Breo Ellipta se convierte en la opcion de marca mas economica con un Precio Maximo Justo de $67, seguido de Trelegy Ellipta a $175.
